meta.title: System composition and topology
meta.subtitle: two GameApis, two QuestMissions share one gamequest RouteMesh · owner selected per PlayerId

cards.title: Roles
items: GameApi owns the session actor and gameplay edge, distributing connections. QuestMission provides the PlayerQuestSpot Instance factory.
The Framework selects the owner per PlayerId using Location Store authority and capacity.
The two roles share one RouteMesh, without creating a per-mission ChannelName.

cards.title: Message roles
items: STREAM delivers client requests, responses, and pushes.
RouteMesh delivers Spot direct messages between GameApi and QuestMission nodes.
